title: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, a user who holds the "power" Splunk…
description: A vulnerability in Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17 allows a user with the "power" role to store attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) in a shared data model. This occurs because the Data Model Editor does not properly neutralize data model field names when building a preview search. Exploitation requires phishing the affected user to initiate a request in their browser, limiting the attacker's ability to exploit at will.
